teaser: What happens when the ability to lead meets a mind built to plan ten moves ahead? You are a 1, the number of the one who goes first, crossed with INTJ, the architect who builds the whole structure before laying the first brick. The 1 wants to move, to claim the room, to be the one deciding; the INTJ wants to have already decided, quietly, before the room exists. In you those two tend to run in the same direction: the outcome is rarely doubt, more often a plan executed with unusual sureness, and a resistance to being told that the plan could be wrong.
